title: Extraction Prep with Kingfisher Flex Extractor
author: Opentrons
materials: Controls are added to sample plate
Proteinase K is added to samples
Magnetic beads are added to samples

steps.title: Set number of samples
steps.instruction: Specify the number of populated wells (1‑96, include controls) that will be filled in the sample, elution buffer, ethanol, NPW3, and NPW4 blocks.

steps.title: Set bead mix repetitions
steps.instruction: Specify the number of mix repetitions to resuspend magnetic beads each time the pipette returns to the reservoir.

steps.title: Mount P1000 pipette
steps.instruction: Mount the P1000 Single Channel pipette (GEN2) on the designated mount.

steps.title: Mount P300 pipette
steps.instruction: Mount the P300 Multi‑Channel pipette (GEN2) on the designated mount.

steps.title: Load samples onto plate
steps.instruction: Ensure samples are pre‑loaded onto the sample plate before starting the protocol.

steps.title: Add controls
steps.instruction: Add the appropriate controls to the sample plate wells as specified.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Dispense Proteinase K into each sample well according to the required volume.

steps.title: Add magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Transfer magnetic beads to each sample well, iterating over source wells (e.g., A1, A2, A3, A4, …) and splitting the total volume equally among the wells.

steps.title: Prep ethanol block
steps.instruction: Prepare the ethanol reagent block, distributing the required volume equally into each well as shown in the deck layout.

steps.title: Prep NPW3 block
steps.instruction: Prepare the NPW3 reagent block, distributing the required volume equally into each well as shown in the deck layout.

steps.title: Prep NPW4 block
steps.instruction: Prepare the NPW4 reagent block, distributing the required volume equally into each well as shown in the deck layout.

steps.title: Prep elution buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the elution buffer block, distributing the required volume equally into each well as shown in the deck layout.
